acceptance.selection: Retain every grid probe. For propagation verification use the lowest declared positive grid sample that propagates to both arms for each opsin. The same absolute stimulus is used for every time, spatial and native comparison; no amplitude fitting, baseline correction, normalization of current or time shift.
acceptance.scope: Published kinetic sets plus an explicitly hypothetical fourth construct. No claim of biological calibration or an automatic channel multiplier.

grid.reason: The initial expression multiplier 10 grid produced no propagating response for ChR2 or Chrimson. Retain that grid and extend the declared hypothetical expression grid for positive implementation tests.
grid.selection: Lowest expression multiplier, then lowest local irradiance with both arms recruited. Every grid probe is retained. Freeze the chosen absolute stimulus for native, time and spatial checks.

scope: Nonlinear cable implementation and time integration; uniform local irradiance fixtures. Actual nonuniform transported light is tested separately. Positive hypothetical expression fixtures are not measured physiological thresholds.
